Hi Redwood team,

I just completed the quickstart guide and started a small PoC locally — thanks for the clear docs. We’re evaluating inference platforms to replace our homegrown serving layer; primary concerns are latency at scale, prefix caching, and how batching interacts with concurrency.

We have developer intent (self-serve) right now but would like a focused 30–45 minute technical session with an engineer to walk through:
- expected p99 latency for ~256-token responses on a small cluster
- caching best practices and how KV cache persists across restarts
- guidance on batching profiles for a mixed bursty workload

I’m Samir, lead infra at BuildForge AI (samir@buildforge.ai). Happy to share a short workload sample and some token counts ahead of time.

Thanks,
